description: What the studio's window is allowed to do. Deliberately narrow: the frontend reaches everything else through named commands in lib.rs, which are easier to reason about than a broad filesystem grant.

permissions.comment: Choosing a project directory. Note there is no filesystem permission here at all — the backend reads and writes projects itself, so the webview never gets a general file-access grant it could be tricked into using.
Opening a GitHub release page when an update cannot be applied in place.
